storyLead: A dry powder inhaler only works when its particles reach deep into the lung. Nafas’s know-how is the design of that journey.
story1Body: A Tiotoriva capsule is placed in the Capsulizer device and pierced. The powder is ready to lift.
story2Body: The patient’s own inhalation lifts the powder out of the capsule — no propellant gas, no need to time a press with a breath.
story3Body: In the airflow, clumps of powder break into very fine particles. Particle aerodynamics engineering is the design of this moment.
story4Title: The dose reaches the deep lung
story4Body: Fine particles pass through the airways to the bronchi; long-acting tiotropium keeps the airway open with one dose a day.
